title: Pentaryn Portal Cards
description: Turns Foundry's teleport confirmation into destination cards: a thumbnail of the spot, a title and a GM-written description, so players see where each exit leads before they choose. With several destinations the cards are the choice. Card data lives on the destination region (flags.pentaryn-portals) and is edited in the Region config, which also has a Snapshot button that crops the scene art around the region. Respects unrevealed destinations. Teleport party moves PCs with their summons, and summons follow a PC through a scene link. Exposes game.pentaryn.portals.
